mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher rates compress equity valuations through increased discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS has increased by > 0.25% in the past 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate aggressive monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12mo change > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in INDPRO (measured as the 3-month change) indicates a tightening monetary policy that is suppressing industrial activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS 3mo change * INDPRO 3mo change) is not significantly associated with negative 20d returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that is likely to trigger inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE has been below 3.5% for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (measured as the 3-month change) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as a tightening labor market fuels economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE has declined by > 0.1% in the past 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month change in HOUST (housing starts) exceeds 2.0%, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy enters a growth phase.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST 3mo change > 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising INDPRO and declining PAYEMS (non-farm payrolls) signals a weakening labor market and slowing industrial production, which is associated with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a slowdown.
failure_condition: The interaction term (INDPRO 3mo change * PAYEMS 3mo change) is not significantly associated with negative 60d returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In a stable growth regime (GDPC1 3mo growth > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL 12mo change < 2.0%), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to favorable economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 3mo growth > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL 12mo change < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05).
